evidence: Registered new user (name=Seller One, email=seller1.qa@example.com, password=password123, location=Seattle, WA). After submit, redirected to home with header showing Sell/cart/user-menu instead of Login/Signup, confirming active session. User menu displays "Seller One" and "seller1.qa@example.com".

issue: Unauthenticated direct navigation to protected routes yields a blank page instead of a sign-in prompt or redirect
actual: While signed out, clicking "Add to Cart" on a product page correctly redirects to /login (good). However, directly navigating to http://localhost:6023/create-listing or http://localhost:6023/cart while unauthenticated renders a completely blank page (document.body.innerText === "", no header, no content, no redirect, no error) instead of a clear sign-in prompt or redirect to login. Reproduced twice for /create-listing.

evidence: Attempted sign-in with email seller1.qa@example.com (not registered in current app state) and password "password123". After submit, page remained on /login with the form still showing entered values and no error toast; no authenticated session was created (header user-menu/Sell/Cart controls did not appear).

Created listing "QA Test Upcycled Chair": added 1 sample photo, description, price $120, category Furniture, condition Good, location Seattle WA, upcycled=true. After submit, redirected to My Listings showing it Active, $120. Product detail page (prod-1787689015601) displays all submitted data: photo, "Upcycled" badge, title, $120, Furniture/Good, Seattle WA, Listed 2026-08-25, description text, and seller "Seller One".

Submitting the create-listing form fully empty triggered native "Please fill out this field" validation on the Title (and other required) fields, blocking submission. Submitting with all fields filled but no photo attached produced a visible toast "Please add at least one image" and did not create the listing (stayed on /create-listing, no navigation to My Listings).

Price field is a numeric input with min=0. Entering "-10" and submitting kept the user on /create-listing without creating the listing; field validation reports "Value must be greater than or equal to 0." Attempting to type non-numeric text "abc" into the price field was rejected outright by the browser (input type=number blocks non-numeric characters).

issue: No edit/update action exists for an existing listing
actual: On My Listings, the only seller-management actions available per listing are "View", "Mark Sold", and "Delete" (confirmed via semantic_snapshot action group and full accessibility snapshot). The owned listing's detail page only offers a "Manage Your Listings" link, no edit control. There is no UI path to modify title, description, photos, price, category, condition, location, or upcycled status of an existing listing.

evidence: On My Listings, clicked "Mark Sold" on owned listing prod-1787689015601: status changed to "Sold" and button relabeled "Mark Available"; clicked again and status reverted to "Active". Clicked "Delete" which opened an alertdialog "Delete listing? This action cannot be undone..." with Cancel/Delete buttons; confirming Delete immediately removed the listing, leaving My Listings showing "No listings yet".

Marked listing prod-1787689182582 ("FT4 Sold Test Item") as Sold via My Listings. Browse/home page item count remained "10 items available" and the sold item no longer appears in browse.products results. Its product detail page shows "This item is no longer available" and the Add to Cart / Message Seller actions are absent (not offered for purchase).

Viewed listing prod-1 owned by seller "Emma Green" while signed in as "Seller One". No seller-management controls (Manage Listings link, Mark Sold, Delete) appeared; only buyer actions Add to Cart and Message Seller were shown. By contrast, viewing an owned listing (prod-1787689182582) showed a "Manage Your Listings" link and My Listings exposed Mark Sold/Delete for it.

Signed in as Seller One, added prod-1 (Emma Green's "Mid-Century Modern Armchair", $285) to cart. Cart page shows 1 item, "Mid-Century Modern Armchair" with photo, location "Brooklyn, NY", price $285, and correct Total $285.00.

Clicking Add to Cart produced an immediate toast "Added to cart!" and the header cart badge updated from empty to "1" without any page reload. Navigating to Cart (SPA link) showed the line item, correct count "1 item", and total "$285.00" immediately.

On prod-2 (seller Marcus Chen, not owned by signed-in buyer Seller One), opened Message Seller dialog, Send button was disabled while empty, typed a non-empty message and Send became enabled. Clicking Send produced visible toast confirmation "Message sent to seller!".

issue: No seller-facing feature to view purchase requests or buyer messages
actual: As buyer "Seller One", added prod-1 to cart and sent a purchase request (toast: "Purchase requests sent to sellers!", cart emptied). Logged in as the item's actual seller "Emma Green" and searched all available surfaces (user menu: My Profile [404 - not found], My Listings, product detail page for prod-1) for any request/inbox/notification view. None exists: My Listings only shows View/Mark Sold/Delete with no requests indicator, and the owned product detail page shows no buyer messages or purchase-request list. There is no way for a seller to view a submitted purchase request or its buyer message.

evidence: Search "wooden" and "WOODEN" both matched only "Kids Wooden Train Set" (title match, case-insensitive), count=1. Search "portland" matched 3 items whose location is "Portland, OR" (location match). Clearing the search restored all 10 items.

Typing into the search box (via fill, simulating live input) updated both the result list and the "N items available" count immediately without any separate submit action, for each of "wooden", "WOODEN", "portland", and clearing back to empty.

issue: No maximum-price filter control exists; the "Price Range" slider only has a Minimum thumb
actual: Combining Category=Furniture + Condition=New correctly returned 2/2 matching items. Setting the price slider to $250 (min) correctly excluded the $175 item, leaving only the $320 item ≥$250. However, DOM inspection of the Price Range control (data-semtag-id=browse.filters.price) shows only ONE slider thumb, aria-label="Minimum" — there is no second "Maximum" thumb in the DOM or in tab order (Tab from the minimum thumb moves directly to "Clear all filters"). The displayed "$X - $500" label is misleading since $500 (the upper bound) cannot be changed by the user. Category, condition, and distance filters, plus Newest/Price/Distance sort, all worked correctly and combined properly, but the checklist's required "maximum price" filter is not actually implemented/exposed.

evidence: Toggling Category (Furniture), Condition (New), Upcycled-only, and the price minimum slider each immediately updated the result list and "N items available" count without a submit action (10→3→2 items as filters were added). Changing sort (Newest→Price Low-High→Distance) immediately reordered results correctly (ascending price: 35,45,55,65,95,125,175,180,285,320; distance grouping by proximity). Clicking "Clear all filters" immediately restored all 10 unfiltered listings and reset all filter controls to their default state.

issue: Category selection from /categories page does not filter browse results
actual: Clicking the 'Furniture' category card on /categories navigated to /?category=furniture (URL updated), but the Browse All Items page displayed all 10 items with count '10 items available' instead of the 3 furniture items listed on the categories page. The Furniture checkbox in the sidebar filter panel remained unchecked (value=false). The category query parameter is not applied to the actual filter/result state.

evidence: Registered account with email duptest.qa@example.com. Attempting to register a second account with the exact same email produced toast "An account with this email already exists" and no new session was created (stayed on /register). Attempting again with a case-only variation (DUPTEST.QA@example.com) also correctly produced the same "already exists" rejection, confirming case-insensitive duplicate email detection. Original account was not replaced (original name/session data intact).

Duplicate-email registration attempts immediately produced a visible toast "An account with this email already exists" without any page navigation/reload. The registration form remained fully populated and editable (Full Name, Email, Password, Location all retained entered values) allowing immediate correction, e.g. changing the email and resubmitting.

issue: Login succeeds with an incorrect password for a non-demo registered account
actual: Registered account duptest.qa@example.com with password "CorrectPass123". Logged out, then attempted sign-in with the same email but wrong password "WrongPassword999" (this account is not one of the documented demo accounts where "any password works"). The app nonetheless created an authenticated session: page navigated to home with header showing Sell/Cart/user-menu, and the user menu displayed "Dup Test User" / "duptest.qa@example.com" — i.e. successfully signed in despite the incorrect password. Password is not actually validated on login.

evidence: Product detail page for prod-1 "Mid-Century Modern Armchair" consistently displays: photo gallery (main image + prev/next thumbnail controls), "Upcycled" badge, title, price ($285), category (Furniture) and condition (Like New) badges, location with distance ("Brooklyn, NY (2.5 mi)"), listing date ("Listed 2024-11-20"), description text, and seller name/location ("Emma Green", "Brooklyn, NY"). Availability is reflected via presence of Add to Cart/Message Seller actions for this active listing; contrastingly, for the sold listing tested in FT-4, the detail page instead displayed "This item is no longer available" text with the purchase actions removed, confirming availability status is also consistently surfaced. Non-upcycled items (e.g. prod-7 Yoga Mat) correctly omit the "Upcycled" badge, confirming the field is data-driven and consistent.
